paragraphs.text: Aimee Ogden is an American Science Fiction writer, currently living in the Netherlands.

Ogden is a former science teacher and software tester. Her short fiction has appeared in venues such as Analog , Fireside , and Beneath Ceaseless Skies . Her debut novella Sun-Daughters, Sea-Daughters , was released in February 2021. Her most recent novella, Starstruck came out in June 2025. Aimee is the co-founder, co-publisher, and former co-editor of Translunar Travelers Lounge , a speculative fiction magazine devoted to fun, optimistic stories.
For Wizards of the Coast , Ogden wrote a Magic Story for Edge of Eternities .
